description: Defines the SQLitePersistentCookieStore class implementing persistent cookie storage using SQLite, including methods for loading, adding, updating, deleting cookies, and managing database operations.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentCookieStore
classes.description: Implements persistent cookie storage using SQLite, managing cookie load, add, update, delete, and database operations.

methods.name: DeleteAllInList
methods.description: Deletes cookies matching origins in the provided list.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads cookies asynchronously, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: LoadCookiesForKey
methods.description: Loads cookies associated with a specific key.

methods.name: AddCookie
methods.description: Adds a new cookie to the store.

methods.name: UpdateCookieAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a given cookie.

methods.name: SetForceKeepSessionState
methods.description: Forces session cookies to be kept.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before committing changes.

methods.name: GetQueueLengthForTesting
methods.description: Returns the number of queued database operations for testing.
